    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    # find full bar row or column
    bar=None; orient=None
    for i in range(H):
        if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]!=0: bar=('row',i); orient='v'
    if bar is None:
        for j in range(W):
            col=[g[i][j] for i in range(H)]
            if len(set(col))==1 and col[0]!=0: bar=('col',j); orient='h'
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    if orient=='v':  # bar is a full row; values in each column stack directly above/below the bar
        bi=int(bar[1]); vals=[]
        for j in range(W):
            v=[g[i][j] for i in range(H) if g[i][j]!=out[bi][j]]
            # slide up toward bar: compact so bottom sits on bar-1, preserving order
            if bi==H-1:   # above bar -> stack upward contiguously
                tgt=barpos=bi-1-len(v)
                for k,x in enumerate(v): out[tgt+k][j]=x
            else:          # below bar -> downward contiguous
                tgt=bi+1
                for k,x in enumerate(v): out[tgt+k][j]=x
    else:              # bar is a full column; values in each row shift toward it, preserving row profile
        bj=int(bar[1])
        if bj==0: sgn=-1   # slide left toward bar
        else: sgn=1
        for i in range(H):
            v=[g[i][j] for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=out[bj][i]]
            if bj==0: tgt=bj+1+len(v)-1   # leftmost touches bar+1
            else:     tgt=bj-1-len(v)     # rightmost touches bar-1
            for k,x in enumerate(v): out[i][tgt+k*sgn]=x
    return out

import os,glob,re,json
base='/home/USER/runs/rt/dagger-u4-disjoint/frozen/held-out-2/play/users/u093/system/state/sessions/'
def loadf(p):
    t=open(p).read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=loadf(base+'01a1aba3-f92d-735e-b515-6da945d97491.jsonl')
i=G['Demo pair 1 input']; o=G['Demo pair 1 output']
print('pair1')
for r in range(10):
    ci=[(c,i[r][c]) for c in range(6) if i[r][c]!=0]
    co=[(c,o[r][c]) for c in range(6) if o[r][c]!=0]
    print(r,ci,'->',co)

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    # find which edge holds a solid non-zero band
    left=all(v==g[0][0] and v!=0 for r in range(H) for c in range(1,W) if False)
    ok = any(all(g[r][0]==band for r in range(H)) for band in {g[r][0] for r in range(H)} if True)
    def is_band_line(cells): return len(set(cells))==1 and next(iter(set(cells)))!=0
    if is_band_line([g[r][0] for r in range(H)]):   # band on LEFT edge
        b=0; band=g[0][0]
        for r in range(H):
            nz=[v for v in g[r] if v!=0 and v!=band]
            start=b+1
            for k,v in enumerate(nz): out[r][start+k]=v
            for j in range(len(out[r])):
                out[r][j]= band if j==b else (nz[j-b-1] if j>b else 0)
        return out
    up=is_band_line([g[0][c] for c in range(W)])    # band on TOP edge
    if up:
        band=g[0][0]
        for c in range(W):
            col=[g[r][c] for r in range(H)]
            nz=[v for v in col if v!=0 and v!=band]
            rng=list(range(1,H))
            for k,v in enumerate(nz): out[rng[k]][c]=v
            for r in range(H):
                out[r][c]= band if r==0 else (nz[r-1] if r>0 else 0)
        return out
    return out

def solve(g, order_key):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    objs=comps_of(g,bg)
    objs.sort(key=order_key)
    res=[r[:] for r in g]; occ=set()
    for v,cc in objs:
        cur=list(cc)
        while True:
            nxt=[(y,x+1) for y,x in cur]
            if any(x>=W or (res[y][x]!=bg and (y,x) not in set(cur)) or (y,x) in occ for y,x in nxt): break
            cur=nxt
        for y,x in cur: res[y][x]=v; occ.update(cur)
    return res

# Hypothesis: within each row, non-background non-wall cells are packed right against the '2' wall,
# preserving relative horizontal order (like gravity right, per-row compression).
def solve_rowpack(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    res=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i in range(H):
        seq=[g[i][j] for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=bg and g[i][j]!=2]
        # find wall position in this row (if any)
        wall=[j for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==2]
        base=W-len(seq)  # pack so last cell touches the wall column
        if wall: base=max(wall)-len(seq)+1
        for k,v in enumerate(seq): res[i][base+k]=v
        if wall: res[i][max(wall)]=2

def solve_demo():
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r_ in inp for v in r_); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    objs=[(v,sorted(c)) for v,c in comps_of(inp,bg)]
    # order: bottom-most cell first (max row desc)
    objs.sort(key=lambda o:-max(y for y,_ in o[1]))
    res=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    def blocked(ns):
        return any(x>=W or res[y][x]==2 for y,x in ns) or \
               any(res[y][x]!=bg and res[y][x]!=2 and (y,x) not in set(cc) for y,x in ns for cc in [])
    for v,cc in objs:
        cur=list(cc)
        while True:
            ns=[(y,x+1) for y,x in cur]
            okm=all(x<W and res[y][x]!=2 for y,x in ns) and all((y,x) not in set(other_cc) for y,x in ns for other_cc in [] )
            # proper overlap check
            okm=all(x<W and res[y][x]==bg or (y,x) in set(cur) for y,x in ns) and not any(x>=W or res[y][x]==2 for y,x in ns)
            if not okm: break
            cur=ns
        for y,x in cur: res[y][x]=v
    # put back the 2 wall
    for i in range(H):
        if inp[i][W-1]==2: res[i][W-1]=2
    return res
print(solve_demo()==out)
